text.p: Novadigm Inc Wednesday said two board members, Dennis DeCoste and Michele Axelson, have resigned.

In a statement the company said the reasons for the resignations were principally attributable to differences of opinion with respect to various strategic alternatives under consideration by the company, and to other matters concerning the board of directors.
The company said that it has initiated discussions to fill the vacated director positions in the near future.

"We accept these resignations with regret," the company said. "The restructuring process has been difficult for Novadigm employees, customers and shareholders. However, we believe that our new organization and business plan will allow us to pursue our goals of renewed growth and a return to profitability by the end of this fiscal year."
